description.text: Program Introduction The MBA is designed to cultivate business management executives of the future for senior leadership positions in China and globally.Studying an MBA in China equips students with strategic foresight and entrepreneurial spirit as well as decision-making and problem-solving capabilities. The MBA is a top international Business qualification from an internationally recognised and prestigious university, one that is well respected by employers in China and around the world. Teaching Objective Beijing Jiaotong University’s MBA will provide students with global business strategic and functional knowledge and experience, but with a strong focus on China and a Chinese business perspective. The experience, coupled with the compulsory learning of Mandarin alongside MBA classes, results in graduates having a China skillset that is in demand with both international and Chinese employers. ●Most classes involve collaboration and networking with fellow students ●Teamwork and group projects are a key component of the course ●Business Master Classes hosted by leading professionals enhance students’ employ-ability and network opportunities ●All students undertake an internship with an international or Chinese business Main Courses General Theory of China’s Economy Strategic Management Data, Models and Decisions Managerial Economics Enterprise Resource Information Management Corporate Finance Operations Management Organisation Behaviour International Business Corporate Governance Entrepreneurial Management Financial Accounting Modern Logistics and Supply Chain Management Business Competitive Intelligence Leadership Project Management Tax Theory and Practice Chinese Language Panorama of Contemporary China Internship As part of the programme, all students go through an internship with an international or Chinese business locally in Beijing or in the nearby region. This is an excellent opportunity for students to put their learning to the test in the real world, gain real experience, and build business networks.

duration.text: The MBA at Beijing Jiaotong University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form completely filled up 2. Photocopy (scanned copy or facsimiled copy) of passport details 3. Your recent photo with white background 4. Notarized diploma and transcripts in English or Chinese 5. Two recommendation letters by associate professors or above 6. English Proficiency Certificate

requirements.text: 1. In the age bracket of 22-40 2. Be in good health 3. Bachlor's Degree or equivelance
